statement_punch.title: Your customers already explain why they come back. They just say it **somewhere else**.
statement_punch.subtitle: In reviews, comments and searches. That is where we listen.
statement_punch.notes: Hook: the reasons people come back are already in public conversation.

questions_client.context: Aurora Coffee opened in three new cities this year and launched a cold drinks line. What comes next depends on what people say before, during and after each visit.

items.question: When do people pick a specialty café, and when does the chain win?
items.detail: Occasion beats price in everyday coffee.

items.question: Where does paying more feel right, and where does it feel expensive?
What makes people try a new cold drink, and what holds them back?
How do people talk about the brand where they don't know it yet?
